queries.query: large language model network configuration generation intent-to-configuration NetOps "LLM" "network configuration"
queries.rationale: Locate primary work applying LLMs to translate operator intent or natural language into device configurations and policy artifacts (operational use-cases, case studies, tool prototypes).
Find studies and architectures that combine generation with automatic validation and iterative repair targeting network configs or similar structured artifacts.

queries.query: network configuration verification Batfish VeriFlow NetKAT Minesweeper "reachability" "ACL"
queries.rationale: Survey deterministic/formal network-verification systems used to check reachability, isolation, and ACL correctness (useful as verifiers/validators for LLM outputs).

queries.query: agentic AI frameworks for operations LLM agents orchestration tool use "autonomous agent" "operations"
queries.rationale: Capture literature on multi-tool LLM agents, orchestrators, and agentic research systems relevant to autonomous NetOps workflows and safety controls.

queries.query: LLM hallucination structured output "schema validation" "hallucination mitigation"
queries.rationale: Identify mechanisms and evaluations addressing hallucination and invalid structured outputs (e.g., syntactic/semantic schema checking, constrained decoding).

queries.query: constrained generation decoding methods constrained decoding "structured output" "safety filters"
queries.rationale: Find method literature on constrained decoding, template-based generation, guarded generation, and filters to enforce syntactic/semantic constraints for configs.
Locate existing benchmarks and datasets for LLMs/AIOps in networking; assess their scope, metric choices, and limitations for operational validation.

queries.query: network emulation Mininet ns-3 testbed evaluation "network configuration" "reproducible"
queries.rationale: Collect papers and repos describing emulators/simulators and reproducible testbeds used to execute or validate network configurations produced by tools/agents.

queries.query: metrics operational correctness reachability connectivity performance-preserving "network configuration" evaluation metrics
queries.rationale: Identify meaningful operational metrics (reachability, isolation, performance impact, policy compliance) and how they are measured in network-validation work.

queries.query: adversarial testing LLM prompts "adversarial prompts" "robustness" "network configuration"
queries.rationale: Search for adversarial evaluation techniques (both input perturbations and targeted prompts) that reveal brittle or unsafe model behavior relevant to NetOps tasks.

queries.query: program synthesis and config generation "program synthesis" "config generation" DSLs schema inference
queries.rationale: Survey program-synthesis and DSL-based approaches for generating correct-by-construction structured artifacts; applicable techniques for network config generation.

queries.query: human-in-loop NetOps AI-assisted operations "human-in-the-loop" verification operator oversight
queries.rationale: Gather evidence on human oversight models, decision support, and human–AI collaboration effectiveness in operational network tasks.

queries.query: provenance auditable logs reproducibility autonomous agents "provenance" "audit" "reproducibility"
queries.rationale: Find best practices and systems for provenance, logging, and reproducibility in automated operational agents to support auditing and rollback.

queries.query: safety, regulations, ethics autonomous network operations "responsible AI" "operational safety"
queries.rationale: Collect policy, safety, and ethical frameworks relevant to deploying autonomous NetOps systems and agentic AIs in operational infrastructure.

queries.query: case studies LLMs in production operations incidents misconfiguration "postmortem" "misconfiguration"
queries.rationale: Locate empirical incident analyses and case studies where automation or configuration errors caused outages—valuable for grounding operational threat models.

inclusion_criteria: Works addressing LLMs, generative models, or agentic systems applied to NetOps, configuration, or operational workflows.
Network verification, formal methods, and deterministic validators relevant to validating generated configurations.
Papers, technical reports, and repos providing methods, metrics, datasets, emulators, or reproducible evaluation artifacts.
Preprints and conference/journal papers (arXiv and peer-reviewed venues) through 2026 to capture the latest LLM/agent research.
Empirical incident analyses, operator studies, and human-in-the-loop evaluations informing practical threats and mitigations.
exclusion_criteria: Purely editorial/opinion pieces lacking methodology or empirical evidence unless they contain operational case studies or standards guidance.
Proprietary, closed-access datasets or non-public incident reports that cannot be inspected or reproduced.
Works unrelated to networking or operational correctness (e.g., purely conversational LLM evaluations without structured-output focus).
Benchmarks or toy tasks that only measure trivia-like knowledge about networking without operational validation or verification.
date_rationale: Include foundational network-verification and NetOps literature (approx. 2010 onward) together with the most recent LLM/agent research up to 2026 to capture both classical verifiers (Batfish, NetKAT, VeriFlow, Minesweeper) and rapid developments in LLMs, agents, and safety/robustness (2021–2026). This span balances historical methods and current LLM-era mitigation techniques.
